thread:
Dana (Design): Quick flag — compact trace card: corr-id pill + tiny download chevron + hover helper clustered into ~40px. Mobile users tap the wrong one frequently. Anyone else noticing? :grimacing:
Ravi (EngRuntime): Yep, support sees accidental downloads. Download calls a heavy snapshot endpoint so it spikes infra.
Mira (Product): Do we have metric for compact vs detail downloads? Might inform discoverability tradeoffs.
Dana (Design): Looked at analytics — ~33% of downloads start from compact cards last 30d. Proposal: corr-id = primary single-tap copy; move download into overflow (kebab). Add visible focus ring and a small keyboard hint (focus then press C).
Omar (Accessibility): +1. Add aria-label="Copy correlation id" and a polite live region announcing "Correlation ID copied to clipboard". Kebab should use role=menu with proper aria-expanded. Avoid shortcut collisions.
Lena (EngPlatform): Dev notes: kebab after chip, roving tabindex for action buttons, menu items navigable by arrow keys, Esc closes. I'll add client-side debounce and server-side rate-limit for exports. Also show toast "Preparing download..." and spinner for long exports.
Ravi (EngRuntime): Backend: if trace >5MB return 202 and a job id, provide polling endpoint for progress. Don't block workers with sync export.
Mira (Product): UX tradeoff: hiding download reduces accidents but hurts discoverability. Suggest kebab in compact view, keep a clear download CTA on detail page. Capture telemetry (source: compact/detail, confirm counts).
Dana (Design): I'll post 2 mocks: A) corr-chip primary + kebab menu labeled "Download trace JSON". B) inline icon with first-click confirm and undo toast. Will annotate a11y behaviors.
Omar (Accessibility): Prefer kebab-only for SR simplicity. If we keep confirm modal, ensure focus trap and proper announcements.
Lena (EngPlatform): I'll own keyboard impl and NVDA/VoiceOver passes.
Mira (Product): I'll draft release note and update support docs about the shortcut and behavior change.
Dana (Design): Plan: final mock by EOD, tagging @Lena @Ravi for implementation review. :thumbsup:
